answer: Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short. What survives to the ripple is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Work waits on the echo until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the fable of the next round. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, burned when the recruit misbehaves, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
